name: Serana

startedBy.speaker: Serana
reply: Thanks! I'll leave it up to you.

objective.text: Find "A Brief History of the Empire V.4" and give it to Serana

movedBy.speaker: Urag gro-Shub
movedBy.prompt: Fine. Where can I find these merchants?
reply: I know you're probably sick of hearing this, but it is all in this note.

movedBy.speaker: Urag gro-Shub
movedBy.prompt: You do know I'm the Archmage, do you?
reply: Oh yeah. I guess I forgot that the Psijic Order suddenly appeared out of nowhere and said:
"Hey! See that kid that joined the College last week? Yeah, put 'em in charge!"
Here you go, all four of them. Tell her to be careful.
movedBy.conditions: The Eye of Magnus completed; the speaker is Urag gro-Shub

startedBy.speaker: Serana
startedBy.prompt: Fine... Let me find a safe location to do this.
reply: Thank you for understanding.
I'll let you choose the place. Once you lay down, I'll wait until you fall asleep. You won't notice anything. I promise.
startedBy.source: SDER_TIF__050BBDE6.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:000089 (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

firstObjective.text: Find a place to sleep (tavern recommended)

startedBy.speaker: Serana
reply: What? Oh, sorry. I was just thinking out loud.
Forget I said anything. Let's catch up with the priest before we lose track of him.
startedBy.source: SDER_TIF__05023F16.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:000014 (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Serana
startedBy.prompt: It's fine. You could use a guide, and I need to relax anyway.
reply: Very well, then. I'll follow your lead.
startedBy.source: SDER_TIF__05029020.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:00001E (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

objective.text: Take Serana to the Solitude Windmill

movedBy.speaker: Serana
movedBy.prompt: Here we are. What do you want to do?
reply: Ugh... I don't know why, but I had a feeling you'd bring me here without a plan.
Well, I guess we could start with the windmill. Heard it's one of the city's main attractions.
But you better come up with a plan afterwards.
movedBy.conditions: Solitude in Company stage == 10; you're in Solitude; the speaker is Serana
movedBy.source: SDER_TIF__05038324.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:000022 (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Serana
reply: I could.
Or, I could brew the other potions I mentioned earlier while you talk to her and save time.
Come on, let's get to Whiterun.
startedBy.source: SDER_TIF__0518671B.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:0001A5 (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

movedBy.speaker: Arcadia
movedBy.prompt: Then why not just ask the guards for help?
reply: Because if the guards get involved, her mother will know. And that's when things will get bad for poor Braith.
Saffir is... A harsh mother. Last time her daughter got into trouble, she humbled her right in front of everyone. It broke my heart to see her face.
I don't want poor Braith to go through that again. She may be a problem child, but I don't think she meant bad when she took the potion.
Please, handle this with discretion. And patience. And quickly, before that potion evokes disaster. It's bad for business too.
movedBy.source: SDER_TIF__0518672B.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:0001B5 (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Serana
startedBy.prompt: You made it this far by taking risks, Serana. That's your real strength.
reply: This is very important for you, is it?
Look, I'll... I'll think about it. But I can't promise I'll change my mind.
Just... leave me alone for now.
startedBy.source: SDER_TIF__0519AC21.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:0002A9 (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

firstObjective.text: Ask Fralia Grey-Mane to craft you a ring for Serana

objective.text: Wait for Fralia to have the ring ready

movedBy.speaker: Fralia Gray-Mane
movedBy.prompt: Don't worry about it. Here you go. (900 gold)
reply: Thanks, dear. It will take us a day to have your order ready. Come back tomorrow.
And don't worry. Eorlund is a magnificent craftsman. He'll make the ideal ring for your loved one. Skyforge quality.
movedBy.conditions: the player has at least 900 gold; the speaker is Fralia Gray-Mane
movedBy.source: SDER_TIF__0519AC2E.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:0002B6 (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Serana
startedBy.prompt: Well... I'd figure you'd be into that sort of thing, so...
reply: I think I told you I sneaked away from my family's parties! Why would I--?
Look, we... We should talk about this another time.
startedBy.source: SDER_TIF__0516D1F5.Fragment_0 on INFO SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp:00017F (SeranaDialogueExpansion - Romance.esp)

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
